name: Wu Fang
current_role: Director, Guangdong Fangyuan New Materials (芳源股份, formerly Fangyuan Environment; SSE STAR 688148)
profile: Wu Fang (吴芳) is a director and major shareholder of Guangdong Fangyuan (688148), a Jiangmen-based battery-materials maker, and a concerted-action party of controlling shareholder and chairman Luo Aiping. Per the Q1 2026 report she held ~17.3m shares (3.40%).
interesting_fact: Company filings list Wu Fang as an acting-in-concert party with founder Luo Aiping, who was re-elected chairman of the 4th board in July 2025 while Wu Fang joined that board.
notes: Low public profile; facts from search-result summaries of company filings. Route via company board office / IR (Fangyuan, 688148). Hurun list shares wealth with Luo Aiping.

name: Jin Liangshun
current_role: Founder and former chairman, Jingong Group (精功集团), Shaoxing; group underwent bankruptcy reorganisation from 2019
profile: Jin Liangshun (金良顺) built Shaoxing's Jingong (精功) group from a warp-knitting machinery factory into a ~50bn-yuan conglomerate spanning steel structures, equipment, new materials, yellow wine (Kuaijishan), general aviation and big data, controlling several listed companies. After a 2019 liquidity crisis the group was reorganised and in 2022 control of its listed assets passed to Fang Chaoyang.
interesting_fact: He took yellow-wine brand Kuaijishan (会稽山) through restructuring and onto the Shanghai exchange in 2014, alongside Jingong Steel Structure and Jingong Technology.
deep_cut_fact: He started at 14 as a carpenter (木工) at the Shaoxing Warp Knitting Machinery factory in the 1960s, rising to workshop head and factory director; press dubbed him the 'little carpenter' (小木匠).
notes: Alive as of Dec 2022 article (aged 68); no later confirmation. Sensitive: group collapsed/bankruptcy restructuring 2019-2022 — avoid in outreach. No published contacts found.

name: Zeng Min
current_role: CEO, Horizon Scientific Corp. (Irvine, CA); co-founder and former chairman (2018-Dec 2023) of Venus Medtech (Hangzhou) (HKEX 2500)
profile: Zeng Min (Min Frank Zeng) co-founded Venus Medtech in Hangzhou in 2009 with Eric Zi, developing transcatheter heart valve (TAVR) devices; he chaired the HK-listed company until December 2023. He has been CEO of Irvine-based Horizon Scientific since 2004 and previously sat on the board of LifeTech Scientific.
interesting_fact: Venus Medtech was an early Chinese developer of transcatheter aortic valve replacement devices; Zeng still held ~7.6% of its H shares as of mid-2026.
deep_cut_fact: He holds an undergraduate degree from Tsinghua University and a graduate degree from the University of Texas at Austin.
notes: US-based (Irvine). Venus Medtech had governance turmoil; avoid. Alive status inferred from 2026 shareholding records.

name: Wu Xian
current_role: Chairman, Shenzhen WOTE Advanced Materials (沃特股份, SZSE 002886)
profile: Wu Xian (吴宪) is chairman of Shenzhen WOTE Advanced Materials, a high-performance polymer/specialty materials company founded in 2001 and listed in Shenzhen. Hurun lists his wealth jointly with He Zheng, WOTE's general manager and director.
interesting_fact: In WOTE's 2024 ESG report chairman's letter he framed the company's strategy as becoming a platform for high-performance materials.
notes: Current-role confirmation latest as of April 2025 ESG report. Route via WOTE board secretary/IR office (listed on cninfo).

name: Li Dezhi
current_role: Controlling shareholder (~60% as of Mar 2026), Chongqing Sifang New Material (四方新材, SSE 605122)
profile: Li Dezhi (李德志) is the largest individual shareholder of Chongqing Sifang New Material, a Banan-district ready-mixed concrete producer listed in Shanghai, whose revenue comes entirely from Chongqing. Hurun lists his wealth with Zhang Lilan.
interesting_fact: Ready-mix concrete made up about 90% of Sifang's 2025 revenue of 1.03bn yuan; management has said it is exploring 'new quality productive forces' for a transformation.
notes: Very low profile; personal bio not found. Company had 2025 loss. Route via Sifang board office/IR.
